# The Quiet Machine

A **word-processor front end** for R Markdown, with *italic emphasis*,
[underlined text]{.underline}, and `inline code`. Colours and fonts survive
as [HTML-only styling]{style="font-family: 'Georgia'; font-size: 14pt; color: #d3a35f"}.

::: {style="text-align: center; line-height: 1.5"}
A centred paragraph with generous line spacing.
:::

## Why another editor?

- Write with ordinary Word-like controls.
- Keep a clean `.Rmd` file on disk.
- Let RStudio knit the result.

1. Open a document
2. Type
3. Knit

> Markdown is the source of truth. Formatting that HTML can carry is kept as
> Pandoc attributes.

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r plot, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point()
```

| Statistic | Value |
|:---|---:|
| Mean | 20.1 |
| Median | 19.2 |

---

That is the loop: write here, save there, knit anywhere.
